changes.title: News Wrap: Kennedy Center warns of 'fiscal collapse' without Trump's name on building
changes.summary: In our news wrap Monday, officials at the Kennedy Center are warning of "certain fiscal collapse" unless President Trump's name is added to the exterior of the building, several state election officials tell the News Hour they are bracing for uncertainty over mail-in ballots ahead of the midterms and NATO Secretary-Gen.

changes.title: Lithuania prepares for war, reinforcing its border against Russian tanks
changes.summary: On the edge of NATO territory in the Baltics, there is growing concern about the threat Russia poses. Aaron MacLean visited the capital of Lithuania to see how they're preparing.

changes.title: Poland says it thwarted Russian plot to kill an American citizen in a NATO country
changes.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it marks the first time Russia sought to attack an American citizen in another NATO country.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump secretly left Turkey last month following a NATO summit on a different plane than Air Force One even though many others were still allowed to board. Mr. Trump on Tuesday made his first public comments about the secret switch. Nancy Cordes reports.
